meta.name: aws-cloudfront-cdn
meta.description: Distribute content globally using CloudFront with caching, security headers, WAF integration, and origin configuration. Use for low-latency content delivery.

copy.tagline: 用 CloudFront 加速全球内容分发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要低延迟的全球内容分发和 CDN 配置
copy.tagline_en: Accelerate global content delivery with CloudFront
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need low-latency global content delivery and CDN configuration

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你设置和管理 Amazon CloudFront CDN，包括配置缓存、安全头、WAF 集成和源站，实现全球低延迟内容分发。
howto.when: 当你需要为网站或应用提供低延迟的内容分发，或者要设置、优化 CloudFront 缓存、安全策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 CloudFront 分发，源站指向我的 S3 存储桶。
配置 CloudFront 只允许 HTTPS 访问并设置缓存 TTL。
在我的 CloudFront 分发上启用 WAF 保护。
say.note: Claude 会指导关联 WAF ACL。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you set up and manage Amazon CloudFront CDN, including caching, security headers, WAF integration, and origin configuration for global low-latency content delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need low-latency content delivery for your website or app, or want to set up/optimize CloudFront caching and security policies.

say_en.text: Create a CloudFront distribution with an S3 bucket as origin.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the aws create-distribution command.

say_en.text: Configure CloudFront to enforce HTTPS only and set cache TTLs.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust ViewerProtocolPolicy and cache settings.

say_en.text: Enable WAF protection on my CloudFront distribution.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to associate a WAF ACL.
